description: platformAutomerge is false here (the shared preset turns it on). GitHub's native auto-merge never fired on PRs needing a review: it evaluates the branch's requirements generically, so a bypass granted to the Renovate app does not count. Renovate merging via the API itself does hit that bypass. Costs latency — the merge lands on Renovate's next run rather than the instant checks go green.

customManagers.description: Bump image tags in Podman Quadlet (.container) unit templates, which Renovate's docker-compose manager does not scan. The optional @sha256 group covers images pinned by digest (filestash only ships a rolling :latest, so the digest is what actually moves)

packageRules.description: LinuxServer.io tags look like <upstream>[ubuNNNN][-rN]-lsNNN. Renovate's default docker versioning cannot parse the ubuNNNN glued straight onto the version, so jellyfin was dropped as unversioned, and for the rest it treats the trailing -lsNNN as a compatibility suffix that must match exactly, so homeassistant and mariadb never saw an update either. This regex versioning splits the parts properly; the Ubuntu base is captured unnamed so upgrades may cross ubu2404 to ubu2604, and the ls build number orders the LinuxServer rebuilds
essere and holefeeder are deployed by their own CI — Renovate must not manage their images
Immich Postgres major bumps need a manual dump/restore — surface on the Dependency Dashboard for approval instead of auto-opening a PR
prBodyNotes: :warning: **Major PostgreSQL upgrade — do NOT just merge.** The pg18+ images refuse to start on older on-disk data. Migrate via dump/restore: dump the running cluster, wipe the data dir, let the new image init fresh, then restore (with the immich `search_path` sed fix).
